fields.label: Drive File ID or Link
fields.description: Paste a Google Drive file id OR a share link (either this or Drive File Link). A link is normalized to the id automatically. One entry per Drive file — re-indexing updates the same record.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Auto-filled from the Drive file name if left blank.

fields.label: Source Process
fields.description: The BPMN process model that produced/published this document (blank for manually-indexed reference material like guidelines).

fields.label: Indexed Content
fields.description: Plain-text/Markdown content used for keyword matching by Gather Reference-style Script Tasks. Not a semantic/vector index — see AI integration notes.
